card.fact_statement: Chief of Army Staff Waker-uz-Zaman convened a meeting to call for the creation of an interim government.

card.fact_statement: Economist Debapriya Bhattacharya was appointed to head a committee charged with drafting a white paper on the economy of Bangladesh.
